name: Garage
description: An S3-compatible object store built to be small and self-hosted, here as a single node: one access key and one bucket are created from the generated credentials on the first start, and any S3 client or SDK uses them over the domain. Metadata and objects live on their own volumes.

access.note: Garage has no web interface: S3 clients connect to https://<domain> (path-style, region garage) with the access key id GARAGE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_KEY and the secret GARAGE_DEFAULT_SECRET_KEY from the Variables tab, and the bucket named here already exists. Garage stores that key on the first start and refuses to start if the secret is later changed, so do not rotate it; create further keys with "garage key create" in the container's terminal.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the endpoint S3 clients are configured with; nothing else here changes when it does.

inputs.name: bucket
inputs.label: Bucket
inputs.description: The bucket created on the first start, which the generated key may read and write.

ports.name: rpc
ports.purpose: Cluster RPC, unused by a single node

ports.name: admin
ports.purpose: The admin API and metrics, never published

volumes.name: meta
volumes.purpose: The metadata database: buckets, keys and the object index

volumes.name: config
volumes.purpose: garage.toml, with the RPC and admin secrets

install.content:
# Written by Just Dashboard before the first start: a single-node Garage with
# its metadata and data on this deployment's volumes.
metadata_dir = "/var/lib/garage/meta"
data_dir = "/var/lib/garage/data"
db_engine = "sqlite"
replication_factor = 1

rpc_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3901"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_secret = "{{secret.rpc-secret}}"

[s3_api]
s3_region = "garage"
api_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3900"

[admin]
api_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3903"
admin_token = "{{secret.admin-token}}"
metrics_token = "{{secret.metrics-token}}"

update.notes: Garage upgrades its metadata in place on start within a major version; read the migration guide before a major upgrade and back up the meta volume first.

secrets.name: access-key
secrets.label: Access key id
secrets.description: The S3 access key id of the default key.

secrets.name: secret-key
secrets.label: Secret access key
secrets.description: The S3 secret of the default key; Garage refuses to start if it changes after the first start.

secrets.name: rpc-secret
secrets.label: RPC secret
secrets.description: Authenticates Garage nodes to each other; written into garage.toml.

secrets.name: admin-token
secrets.label: Admin API token
secrets.description: Authorises the admin API, which is not published.

secrets.name: metrics-token
secrets.label: Metrics token
secrets.description: Authorises reads of the metrics endpoint, which is not published.
